lead: Rahul Dravid is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 11 January 1973 in Indore.
As of 2026, he is 53 years old, and his birth date places him under the Capricorn sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Karnataka cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Wisden Cricketer of the Year.
Below you will find a verified overview of Rahul Dravid: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

paras: Rahul Dravid works primarily as a cricketer, international sportsperson and coach.
